weather_report:
Subiaco wakes under a clean, star-washed sky; the small hours are cool and still, with a hint of pale light gathering in the east. Clarity is excellent, the sort that makes rooftops and gum leaves look newly drawn. UV is effectively nil before sunrise, and the silence has that practical sort of calm that makes you notice your own breath.

Expect a bright, mostly cloudless day once the sun lifts, the light sharpening quickly and the UV climbing from gentle to insistent by late morning. It should feel pleasant early, then warm and a bit unforgiving at midday glare, before easing again late afternoon. Dress in light layers now and plan to shed them; a breathable shirt, hat, sunglasses, and a touch of sunscreen will serve you well. Good moments today: a quiet walk before breakfast, watering the garden while the soil still holds the night’s cool, cycling to the shops ahead of the heat, hanging a wash to take advantage of the clear air, or reading in a patch of shade when the sun turns brassy.
